source: Ports: NGA World Port Index (Pub. 150, msi.nga.mil, CSV export; Harbor Size L/M/S/V), assigned to regions via the region-ID raster. Road and rail density: Natural Earth v5.1.1 1:10m Roads and 1:10m Railroads (public domain), line length sampled every 2 km per region ÷ region area.
licence: NGA World Port Index: public domain (US Government). Natural Earth: public domain.
notes: portCapacity = Σ harbour-size weights (L 4, M 2, S 0.8, V 0.3; purely military harbours excluded), capped at 16 — an abstract supply-throughput capacity. infrastructure = clamp(0.08 + 0.92·√((road + 2·rail density) / D)) with D the 92nd-percentile density, so the best-connected tenth of regions score 1.0; Natural Earth roads are generalised, so this is a relative index, not an absolute network length.
